messages:
kevin: Heads-up — customer hitting streaming decode errors in Go SDK v0.9.3. Repro attached. Symptoms: partial JSON chunk ends up as \"unexpected EOF\" or decoder returns garbage after reconnect. Only on hosted prod, not locally.

kevin: Repro steps:
1) use streaming Generate with Go SDK v0.9.3
2) prompt that emits structured JSON (large array)
3) request cancels/retries via our client retryer

kevin: Minimal snippet:
```go
client := redwood.NewClient("$KEY")
stream, _ := client.Completions.Stream(ctx, req)
for {
  chunk, err := stream.Read()
  if err == io.EOF { break }
  if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
  // chunk.Data is raw bytes
}
```

kevin: Log shows partial chunk ending with `...\"records\": [ {\"id\":\"1\",\"v\":\"x\"},` then next chunk starts `\"id\":\"2\"` so scanner thinks JSON object ended incorrectly.

maria: Thanks — are you able to repro with v0.10.0? any stack traces?

kevin: Yes repro fails only on 0.9.3. 0.10.0 on canary didn't fail. stack trace from sdk:
```
json: invalid character '\\n' in string literal
runtime.caller ...
github.com/redwood/sdk/streamer/scanner.go:142: invalid token boundary
```

jon: pinging eng-runtime. Likely scanner stateful buffer wasn't reset on retry; retry path in 0.9.x reuses scanner instance. can you dump stream frames? use `HTTP_PROXY` tool to capture raw chunk boundaries.

kevin: Dump attached (raw frames):
[frame1] `{"records":[{"id":"1","v":"x"},`

[frame2] `{"id":"2","v":"y"},"meta":...}`

kevin: Notice frame2 starts with `{` instead of array continuation — server changed framing after retry.

eng-bot: Deploy 2026-03-15T02:12Z to prod (runtime v2.5.1) includes streaming framing fix.

jon: Workaround for customers: pin SDK to v0.10.0 or set streaming retry to false. I'll open a patch to 0.9.x to reset scanner state on reconnect.

maria: Customer notified, gave temp workaround and ETA. :thumbsup:

kevin: Thanks — I'll follow up with repro artifacts and link to ticket #CS-1287.
